messages.text: Happy to. Which state or country are you mining in, and your order number if you have one, so I price it against your address? I'll run the Harlo B30 ($899, 30 TH/s) and the Magic Miner 40T ($799, 40 TH/s), our two best units per terahash, and show sats per month, power cost at your rate, break-even BTC price and the solo-block odds. If you know your per-kWh rate, give me that too and I'll use it instead of the state average.

At €0.20/kWh (about $0.23), here's where you land today, BTC at $84,981.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 405 W: about 42,900 sats a month, worth roughly $36. Power runs about $68 a month, so you're around $32 down at today's price. Break-even BTC price is about $158,000. Solo block odds roughly 0.17% over a year, block worth about $266,000.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at 650 W: about 57,200 sats a month, worth roughly $49. Power about $109 a month, so around $60 down. Break-even about $190,600. Odds about 0.22% a year.

At that rate neither pays for its power at today's price. The B30 is the cheaper unit to run and the closer to break-even, so it's the one I'd take. Estimate, not a promise, price and difficulty move.
